scripts.test:daily: npm test && node scripts/run-data-tests.mjs unit && npm run validate:data
scripts.test:update: npm run test:daily && npm run data:check && node scripts/run-data-tests.mjs current && npm run build && node scripts/run-data-tests.mjs build
scripts.test:history: node scripts/run-data-tests.mjs history && npm run test:archive
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run validate:data && vite build
scripts.format: prettier --write src scripts docs data '*.json' '*.ts' index.html .github
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src scripts docs data '*.json' '*.ts' index.html .github
